tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa

bzhugs so/ / bka' dang brgyud pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam/ sems can thams cad kyi ded dpon bya bar 'dod pas bde legs 'di ltar spyad par bya ste/ sems bskyed sngon du song ba yis/ /dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan par bya/ /dad pa la yang rnam gsum ste/ /mthong ba dang ni thos pa yis/ /dang po dang ba'i dad pa bskyed/ /dge dang sdig pa mi bslu bas/ /gnyis pa yid ches dad pa bskyed/ /sems nyid skye ba med pa nas/ /gsum pa 'dod pa'i dad pa bskyed/ /mthong ba lha khang mchod khang dang*/ /dam pa'i mdzad spyod ldan rnams la/ /dad sems mos gus bskyed pas kyang*/ /bsod nams nges par 'thob pa yin/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mang thos pas/ /chos la dad sems skye ba yin/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mthong lugs ni/ /snod kyi 'jig rten mi rtag dang*/ /bcud kyi sems can mi rtag mthong*/ /phyi yi 'byung bzhi 'dus pa yang*/ /ri bo ri rab gling bzhi rnams/ /rtag rtag 'dra ste ther zug med/ /me bdun chu gcig 'byung dus na/ /mi rtag 'jig par 'gyur ba yin/ /dbyar dgun ston dpyid de bzhin 'gyur/ /rgyu rkyen can la rtag pa med/ /de bas dngos yul mi rtag go /bcud kyis sems can mi rtag ste/ /'du 'bral skye shi 'di 'dra'o/ / dmyal ba yi dwags sdug bsngal rnams/ /ma brjod brjod na dad ldan rnams/ / dngangs skrag skye ste yi mug 'gyur/ /skye 'gro mi yi sdug bsngal la/ /zur tsam brjod pa 'di ltar yin/ /e ma mi rtag rtag lags sam/ /mtshan dang dpe byad brgyan pa yi/ /rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na/ /chu shing snying po 'dra ba yi/ /lus can rnams la smos ci dgos/ /de bas rtag go ma dgongs shig /ma dang ma la skyes pa'i dus nas ni/ /nyin mtshan 'das shing shi dang phar phar nye/ /mi 'chi 'dod de bdag la rang dbang med/

/skye rga na 'chi rang 'thag ri mo 'dra/ /'chi bdag bdud ni so bya nya sdod 'dra/ /'chi ba'i rkyen ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /'chi ba'i rkyen du ma song dngos po gang yang med/ /lus 'di zas kyis gso yang la la brnangs nas 'chi/ /srog skyabs srung mas byed de la la srung mas gsod/ / dpa' mtshan pha spun byed de la la dme grir 'chi/ /gso byed sman pa yin te la la sman pas gsod/ /rang bas gces pa med de rang srog gcod pa mang*/ / 'jig rten 'di na che chung dbul phyug kun/ /'chi bdag dbang du mi 'gyur sems can gang yang med/ /sngon du shi ba'i mi rnams kun gyis kyang*/ /rtag tu re yi snyan grags gtam bsgrubs kyang*/ /snyan grags phyir lus bdag la phan pa med/ /phan pa'i sems kyang gnod pa rab tu che/ /rang nyid dge sdig gnyis dang 'grogs te 'chi/ /dge ba stobs chung sdig pa stobs che bas/ /mi 'dod pa yi gnas su song na bslad/ /da lta rang nyid gson pa'i ring nyid 'di la yang*/ / gnyen bshes gnyen 'dun mdza' dang mi mdza' kun/ /shi ba thos dang 'chi ba mthong ba kun/ /da lta bgrangs na brla skyi mi 'byung ngam/ /da lta'i sa steng sems can 'di rnams kyang*/ /rang re bsams na rtag go bden snyam yang*/ /lo brgya tshun chad gcig kyang mi lus 'chi/ /sang 'chi gnangs 'chi sus kyang mi shes te// sang phod tshun chod rang dbang thob pa med/ /'chi ba'i tshe na pha ma bu tsha dang*/ /phu nu mdza' bshes bran khol nor rnams kyang*/ /bdag nyid 'chi ba'i phyi na 'ong ba med/ /gces pa shi phyir bdag nyid 'gro ba med/ /de bas skyes kyang bdag nyid gcig pur skyes/ /mtha' mar 'chi yang bdag nyid gcig pur 'chi/ /skad cig tshe 'dir las mthun nye gzhi rnams/ /mgron po lam mthun tsam ste so sor 'gro/ 'o na bu tsha nye gzhis ci zhig phan/ /rang la shin tu phangs pa'i lus 'di yang*/ / rten 'brel ma mthun rdza chag bzhin du bor/

/lhan cig skyes pa'i sha rus so sor bral/ /ma rig sems ni las kyi dbang gis 'khyams/ /ci phyir zhe na 'di ltar dgongs mdzod dang*/ /lus 'di sgyu ma 'dra ste 'jig la khad/ /dbugs ni na bun 'dra ste yal la khad/ /sems ni glog dang 'dra ste 'gyu la stong*/ /dga' zhing gces par gsos pa'i bu tsha yang*/ /de lta'i chos can yin no go ba longs/ /sku drin lus srog bskyed pa'i pha ma yang*/ /de lta'i chos can yin no go ba longs/ / shes mthun yid du 'ong ba'i zla grogs kyang*/ /de lta'i chos can yin no go ba longs/ /gnas skabs sha khrag gcig pa'i tshe zla yang*/ /de 'dra'i chos can yin no go ba longs/ /byams sems brtse gdung che ba'i gnyen bshes kyang*/ /de 'dra'i chos can yin no go ba longs/ /phyi nang dam tshig 'brel ba'i slob dpon yang*/ /de lta'i chos can yin no go ba longs/ /pha dgra bu gshed byas pa'i dgra rnams kyang*/ /de lta'i chos can yin no go ba longs/ /de bas lus dang longs spyod gang la yang*/ /rtag pa po ni yod pa ma yin te/ /bdag dang bu tsha rnams la phan snyam nas/ /ser sna 'jur 'gegs gnyis dang bsdongs nas ni/ /dgos shing phongs par bsags pa'i zas nor yang*/ /dgra rdzas 'dre rdzas lto ba'i nang na 'dzad/ /'jig rten 'di yi bde ba'i longs spyod kyang*/ /phal cher phyi ma'i sdug bsngal ngan song rgyu/ /bzang zhing btsan par brtsigs pa'i yul mkhar yang*/ /phal cher nga rgyal chags sems sdug bsngal snon/ /mtha' mar 'jig par 'gyur ba'i chos can yin/ /rtag go bden no snyam pa'i bsam pa yang*/ / snyan grags bde skyid bya bar kun 'dod de/ /'dus byas mi rtag dbang gis so sor 'bral/ /rtag par 'dug gam de ni mi 'dug gam/ /snga ma shi ba rnams kyi rjes shul gzigs/ /tshe la jag rkun las ngan 'gyur 'debs shing*/ /mi 'dod gnas su 'gro ba'i grogs po de/ /nam 'ong cha med pa de ya cha na/

/de bas nye bar rang la tshur ltos dang*/ /dar cig 'khyags dang ltogs pa mi bzod na/ / ngan song sdug bsngal yun ring cang bzod dam/ /da lta'i dus su sdig sgrib ma sbyangs na/ /phyis ni rnam smin bde bar gshegs mi khegs/ /rang nyid dge ba'i stobs dang ldan gyur na/ /dmyal bas kyang ni gnod pa mi skyel na/ /sgyu lus phyir ni 'jig par 'gyur ba yis/ /lus dang longs spyod kun la chags mi bya/ / chags par gyur kyang rten 'brel 'jig dus su/ /rgyal bas kyang ni gzung bas mi thub na/ /bar du gcod dam dus kyi 'chi ba'i tshe/ /'byung ba dar ba'i nyams shed stobs dang bral/ /gso bas legs byas sha bkrag mdangs kyang shor/ / nga'o snyam pa'i sems stobs shed kyang chag /'byung ba bzhi yi nus pa rim gyis thim/ /sa ni chu la thim ste rang lus rang mi theg /chu ni me la thim ste kha sna skam zhing tshig /me ni rlung la thim ste lus kyi drod kyang yal/ /rlung ni srog 'dzin yin te phyi na rgyu ba bral/ khang rul zhig ral nang nas mi 'byung bzhin/ /rlung sems bsdad pa med de 'don par 'gyur/ /de ltar lus sems bral bar gyur pa'i tshe// tsha grang na tsha mi bzod lus 'di la/ /bkyig dang drag dang bskyal ba dang*/ / bsregs dang bsha' dang sba ba dang*/ /chu la bskyur ba la sogs byas/ /de lta bu yi dus byung na/ /mdo chung don med 'di ltar gda'/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag gis ma zin na/ /shi 'jigs dad pa'i stobs ni chung*/ /don yod brtson 'grus lcag ni zhan/ /skye med shes rab kyi ngar gyis ma chod na/ /dug lnga'i rba rlabs kyis ni yengs/ /ma rig pa yi mun pas gtibs/ /rang sems bshes med smyon pa 'khyam pa 'dra/ /las kyi dbang gis gang du skyes gyur kyang*/ /dmyal bar skyes na tsha grang bzod thabs med/ /bzod thabs med kyang rang gis bsgrubs pa yin/ /chos skal sdig la byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /tshe tshad ci yod mdo sde'i nang du dris/

/yi dwags skyes na bkres skom bzod thabs med/ /bzod thabs med kyang rang gis bsgrubs pa yin/ /ser sna yid la byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ /tshe 'phos gyur na mi ru skyes nas kyang*/ /dbul phongs na tsha can du skye bar 'gyur/ / byol song skyes kyang bkol spyad bzod pa med/ /bzod pa med kyang rang gis bsgrubs pa yin/ /chos la byol bas byol song gnas su skye/ /bsad bcad bkol spyod sdug bsngal mthong bar bsam/ /shi ba'i shul gyis mi rnams kun gyis kyang*/ /gnyen 'dun byams pa'i mi rnams kun 'dus nas/ /bden par gzung ba spyod yul 'di 'dra zhes/ /brang brdungs skra 'bal smre sngags 'don par byed/ /lus sems bsdus nas kyi hud cho nges 'debs/ khyod kyi las thabs 'di 'dra zer zhing gdung*/ kha la mya ngan byed cing don la rang don bsgrubs/ /lo brgyar bsags pa'i zas dang longs spyod dang*/ /nga yi bsags pa'i sems kyi chags sems skye/ /'gro sar 'khyer rgyu gnas skabs 'brel ba chad/ /rang sems skyabs med bye'u phrug thang lhung 'dra/ /de bas rtag pa'i gnas med 'chi ba sgoms/ /ma bsgoms lags kyang dngos snang kun shi bas/ /sgeg mo'i mgo la me shor ram/ /sdar ma'i pang du sbrul byung ltar/ /gnyen po bsten la rtag tu 'chi ba bsam/ /bsam yang mi dgos sngon du 'chi brdo ste/ /rgan shi gzhon shi yul mi khyim mtshes shi /kun shi bzhin du rang yang 'chi bar nges/ /des na 'chi bar nges pas dam chos mdzod/ /'jig rten 'di na btsan zhing phyug grags kyang*/ /'chi bdag dbang du ma song gang yang med/ /bu tsha la sogs 'khor mang srid bzang yang*/ /rang sems mtshang can gnas par btang ba 'dra/ /des na zhen chags cung zad mi bya'o/ /zhen chags byas kyang rang dbang mi thob par/ / rang gis bsags pa'i nor la gzhan gyis spyod/ /rang nyid nyon mongs lnga dang 'grogs nas 'gro /de ltar bltas shing skyid sdug mthong ba yis/

/'khor ba nyid la blo ldog nges 'byung 'gyur/ /zhes dang ba'i dad pa bskyed pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //yid ches dad pa 'di ltar bskyed par bya/ /mi lus gtsang ma thob pa'i dad ldan rnams/ /snga mar 'khrul te snga mar song zin gyis/ /da ni 'chi ba rjes su dran par gyis/ /byol song phyugs kyi bu ni ma yin pas/ /mi 'chi snyam pa'i sems yod cang srid dam/ /yod na byol song bas kyang shin tu blun/ /mi rtag 'chi bar nges so skal ldan kun/ /mi lus yud tsam 'di la rten chos la/ /dge dang mi dge gnyis la spang blang bya/ /long yod snyam pa'i 'du shes ma byed par/ / byis pa bang 'gyed gom pa stong ba bzhin/ /dge dang mi dge gnyis la de bzhin te/ /dge la rtsod len gyis dang skal ldan kun/ /ci phyir zhe na mi dge skyon che bas/ /mi dge'i skyon ni 'di ltar yin/ /gsod pa yi ni tshe thung zhing*/ /dmyal ba'i gnas su yun ring 'gyur/ /de bas srog gcod spang bar bya/ /rku ba yis ni longs spyod nyams/ /tshe rabs kun tu yi dwags skye/ /de bas rku ba rab tu spang*// byi byas pas ni dgra dang bcas/ /zla grogs snying ni ring bar 'gyur/ /de bas chags pa spang bar bya/ /rdzun du smras pa'i rnam smin ni/ /bden pa'i tshig ni thos mi 'gyur/ /rang gis smras pa'i tshig la yang*/ /bden par 'dzin pa mi 'byung ngo*/ /phra ma yis ni bshes dang 'byed/ /mdza' ba'i grogs dang phrad mi 'gyur/ / bdag la slu bar byed pa mang*/ /de bas phra ma spang bar bya/ /tshig rtsub gzhan la smras pa yis/ /rang gi rna bas snyan mi thos/ /de bas tshig rtsub spang bar bya/ / ngag 'khyal smras pas don mi mthong*/ /ngag 'khyal smra ba'i rnam smin gyis/ / bden pa'i tshig dang phrad mi 'gyur/ /de bas lus ngag ma 'khyal bar/ /shes bzhin bya ra legs par thong*/ /brnab sems kyis ni re ba 'joms/ /re ba thog tu mi phebs pas/ /brnab sems skyon du shes par bya/

/gnod sems byas pa'i rnam smin gzugs/ /mi sdug ston pa de las byung*/ /log par lta ba mi srid de/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun sogs/ khyad du gsod pa ltas ngan yin/ / lus ngag yid gsum 'chal gyur pa'i/ /btung ba'i chang la tshod zin bya/ /de la dus tshad ma zin na/ /bya ba ma yin byed par 'gyur/ /mi bsam pa la sems par 'gyur/ /de bas de la tshod zin bya/ /mi dge ba'i skyon bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las dge ba bcu'i bshad thabs 'di gsungs so/ /srog gcod pa las log nas ni/ /srog skyabs srog ni blu bar bya/ /ma byin len las log nas ni/ /ci 'byor sbyin pa btang bar bya// mi tshangs spyod las log nas ni/ /dad ldan sdom la dgod par bya/ /lus kyi dge ba de spyad pas/ /mi lus gyur dang ldan par 'gyur/ /tshig rtsub las ni log nas su/ /chos dang mthun pa'i gtam snyan bsgrag /ngag 'khyal las ni log nas su/ /mdo dang snying po rgyun du bzlas/ /phra ma las ni log nas su/ /mi mthun pa rnams mthun par sbyar/ /rdzun du smra las log nas ni/ /mi bslu bden pa'i dam chos bshad/ /ngag gi dge ba de spyad pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags par 'gyur/ /brnab sems las ni log nas su/ /byams dang snying rje bsgom par bya/ /gnod sems las ni log nas su/ /sems can kun la phan bde bsgrub/ /log lta las ni log nas su/ /rtag tu 'chi bsam las kyi bsags pa bgrang*/ /dkon mchog gsum mchod ngo bo gnyis med bsgom/ / zhes dge ba bcu'i bshad thabs kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las yid ches pa'i dad pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug la 'jug pa'i thabs 'di gsungs so/ /da ni yid ches pa'i dad pa zhes bya ste sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gsum ste/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa dang*/ zang zing gi sbyin pa dang*/

chos kyi sbyin pa'o/ /tshul khrims la gsum ste/ lus tshul bla ma'i cha lugs ltar rdo rje skyil krung dang*/ tsog pur gnas par bya ba dang*/ phyag dang skor ba dang*/ lam rdul 'phyag pa dang*/ tsha tsha gdab pa dang*/ dul bar gnas pa dang*/ nges par gnas pa dang*/ dus la babs na brtul zhugs bya ba'o/ /ngag gi tshul ni/ mdo dang snying po zlo ba dang*/ gsong por smra ba dang*/ chos kyi gleng bslangs su smra ba dang*/ gong ma'i mgur dbyangs blang ba dang*/ steng rlung mnan 'og rlung 'then/ bar rlung spar bar bya ba yin/ /sems kyi tshul ni/ 'jig rten pa'i bsam pa las log nas/ chos 'ba' zhig sems la gnas pa'o/ /bzod pa la yang gsum ste/ sdang ba dgra la bzod pa ni/ ngan lan ngan gyis mi bya ba dang*/ zhe la mi 'jog pa dang*/ phar gnod pa byas pas rnam smin tshur bzlog cig byas la bsgom/ dka' ba dka' spyad bzod pa ni/ thos bsam sgom gsum la dka' ba spyod pa dang*/ bla ma'i las ka dang*/ dka' ba bzod pa dang*/ dka' thub dang sdom pa la dka' ba bzod pa'o/ /skye med kyi chos la mi skrag mi dngangs pa ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gsum ste/ rang bzhin gyis brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ rang bzhin gyis brtson 'grus che ba'i le lo mi byed pa'o/ /chos kyi brtson 'grus ni/ bya ba gang byed pa'i sngon du dge sbyor thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor las mi 'da' bar byed pa'o/ /rtsol ba dang bral ba'i brtson 'grus ni/ lus ngag yid gsum 'bad brtson dang bral nas/ sog phon zhig pa bzhin du bya ba'i bya ba kun dang bral ba ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /bsam gtan la yang gsum ste/ mi g.yo ba'i bsam gtan ni/ lus mi g.yo ba skyil krung bcas/ ngag mi g.yo ba 'jam rlung gzung*/ sems mi g.yo ba dran pa'i rgyu 'grul bcad pa'o/ /mi gnas pa'i bsam gtan ni/ snang ba la blo mi gnas/

stong pa la blo mi gnas/ gnyis med tsam la blo mi gnas te/ dngos su ngan blo ma skyes pa'o/ /mi 'da' ba'i bsam gtan ni/ lta ba rtogs pa'i ngang ci ltar 'dug kyang*/ sems las mi 'da'/ sems chos nyid stong pa las mi 'da'/ dper na rgya mtsho la rlabs ci ltar byung yang chu las mi 'da'/ de bzhin du sems la ci ltar shar yang don skye med las mi 'da'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gsum ste/ kun rdzob shes pa'i shes rab ni/ ji ltar snang ba thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du shes pa'o/ /chos spyod pa thams cad kyang rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du spyod pa'o/ /don dam shes pa'i shes rab ni/ shes bya las 'das pa'o/ /

log pa'i shes rab ni/ bden par 'dzin pa mtha' dag go /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyad thabs bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las chos spyod bcu'i spyad thabs 'di gsungs so/ /chos spyod bcu ni/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang*/ / nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang*/ /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*/ /de sems pa dang bsgom pa'o/ /bka'am bstan bcos yi ge 'bri ba ni/ rang ngam 'on te gzhan la 'chol/ /de ni chos spyod dang po yin/ /bla ma dus gsum bde gshegs rnams/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul/ /thun bzhir mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /de ni chos spyod gnyis pa'o/ /'byor pa'i chos dang sbyar ba yi/ /ser sna med cing sbyin gtong ni/ /de ni chos spyod gsum pa yin/ /bka'am yang na bstan bcos la/ /mos pa'i sgo nas mnyan byas na/ /'khor 'das sgro 'dogs sems su chod/ /de ni chos spyod bzhi pa yin/ /mdo sde'am ni rgyud sde la/ /dag dang mos dang khengs par bklag /the tshom gcod pa'i go ba rnyed/ /de ni chos spyod lnga pa yin/ /bla ma'i zhal las gsungs pa'am/ /yang na mdo rgyud yig chung las/ /dgos don ma lus blo la 'dzin/ /po ti dmar por tshud pa ni/ /de ni chos spyod drug pa'o/ /chos kun khong du chud nas ni/ /dad ldan mos par ldan pa la/ /la shan phye nas 'chad pa ni/ / bdag gzhan kun gyi don yin pas/ /de ni chos spyod bdun pa yin/ /bka'am yang na bstan bcos la/ /zhal ton rgyun du byed pa ni/ /sgrib sbyong tshogs rdzogs bar chad sel/ /su yis thos kyang bag chags 'jog /de ni chos spyod brgyad pa yin/ /bla mas gsungs pa'i chos rnams la/ /so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis// tshig la sbyor zhing don la sbyar/ /chos sems zhu gtug byas pa yis/ /bsam med dgongs pa thugs su chud/

/de ni chos spyod dgu pa yin/ /mtshan ma lha la bsgom pa dang*/ /mtshan med chos nyid bsgom pa dang*/ /zhi gnas chos nyid bsgom pa dang*/ /zung 'brel mi rtog sgom pa dang*/ /so ma lhan po bsgom pa dang*/ /dwangs sangs ngang la 'jog pa dang*/ /thug phrad rang grol bsgom pa ni/ / de ni chos spyod bcu pa'o/ /de bcu chos kyi sgo mo ste/ /'dren pa rnams kyi gshegs shul yin/ /'di bcu ston pa'i skyes bu yis/ /ma nor lam sna 'dren pa ste/ /yul du gser khungs bye ba yin/ /ci phyir zhe na dgos 'dod thams cad de las 'byung*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las chos spyod bcu spyad pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las byed pa po rang yin pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /ngan song rang gis ma byas pas/ /mi dge ba dag rgyun bcad de/ /mi dge sdig pa spangs pa la/ /ngan song rnam gsum 'byung mi 'gyur/ /mtho ris lam stegs yin pas dge bcu dang du blang*/ /dge spyad ngan song snang ba sgrib/ /sdig spyod mtho ris snang ba sgrib/ /sgrib pa zhes ni de la bya/ / dge bas mtho ris gnas su 'phen/ /sdig pas ngan song gnas su 'phen/ / gzhu yi mda' 'phen bzhin du'o/ /de bas dge sdig spang blang bya/ /rang gis rang don ma bsgrubs na/ khyod la su zhig bde ba ster/ /rta kha srab kyis bsgyur ba bzhin/ /rang gi kha lo mi bsgyur par/ /bde ba gzhan la re ba ni/ /bskal bar bde dang phrad mi 'gyur/ /'di dang phyi mar bde 'dod na/ /sems kyi phu thag khrud mar gyis/ /sems kyi skyon ngan khrud pa ni/ /yul snang mi sdug 'char mi 'gyur/ /sprin ni khra khro can dag gis/ /zhing pa dga' ba'i char mi phebs/ /dge sdig khra khro can dag gis/ /dgos pa'i don ni shor bar 'gyur/ /gser sa rnyed nas mal la shor/ /sa rtod chu rtod ma 'bad na/ /dal 'byor chud zos shin tu phangs/

/zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'jug pa las/ byed pa po rang yin pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las nyams myong zhal ta'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen po 'dra/ /mi lus chu las sgrol ba'i gru dang 'dra/ /de bas byang chub sgrub par dam chos gcig/ phyis ni rten mchog mi lus thob dka' bas/ /legs par soms dang skal ldan pho mo kun/ /don dam ston pa'i slob dpon pha bas lhag /gus pas spyi bor khur zhig skal ldan gcig /chos sgor zhugs pa'i mched grogs ma bas lhag /snying brtse sha tsha gyis shig skal ldan kun/ /dmigs med sems kyi man ngag gter dang 'dra/ /dka' ba nyams su longs shig skal ldan kun/ /stong pa'i ye shes lta ba'i rgyal po 'dra/ /nyam nga bag tsha med do skal ldan kun/ /dmigs zad shes pa bya lam rjes med 'dra/ /rjes shes rnam rtog med do skal ldan kun/ /mngon 'gyur 'bras bu nyi ma sprin bral 'dra/ /'gro don shugs las 'byung ngo skal ldan kun/ /de ltar yon tan 'byung ba'i khe yod pas/ /rkyen ngan nyon mongs dbang du mi btang ngo*/ /lus la skyon mang sems la nyon mongs mang*/ /log 'dren bar chad g.yul ngo'i mda' dang 'dra/ /skad cig yengs su med do skal ldan kun/ / tshe la long med chu yi chu bur 'dra/ /phyis ni long med da lta nyid du bsgrubs/ / myur du brtson 'grus dgos so skal ldan kun/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma sha bcad pa 'dra/ /thar pa'i bde lam 'jigs med lam zhugs 'dra/ khe nyes shes par gyis shig skal ldan kun/ /rtogs nas mi bsgoms cha yod dug za 'dra/ / rang la rang gis ma bslu skal ldan kun/ /tshig mkhas don med 'dab chags ne tso 'dra/ /chos dang sems su bsres shig skal ldan kun/ /thos chung nga rgyal byed na chang gis bzi ba 'dra/ /sgo mo kun nas sdur cig skal ldan kun/

/thos mang rlom sems byed na shes rab bdud/ /tshig gis mtshon du med do skal ldan kun// zhum zhing lta shes chung na dman pa'i bdud/ /rang sems rtogs pas chog go skal ldan kun/ /'dod yon rang dgar spyod na lta ba gol/ /don med gyi nar 'khyams so skal ldan kun/ /dmigs bral dgongs gces skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ yid ches pa'i dad pa nyams su myong ba zhal ta dang bcas pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ 'bral med don ldan gyi dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don du sdig pa spyod pa ni// rnam smin phral la mtshon bzhin mi gtub ste/ /gang na 'gro ba'i sa phyogs de na sdod/ /rang gi las byas rang la rnam par smin/ /gzhan gyi skal med de na mi snang yang*/ /sdig spyad gzhan don byas pas ci zhig bya/ /gzhan gyi don du bdag gis dge spyad na/ /gong bzhin skal ba mi len bdag gi don du 'gyur/ /thar pa rang la rag lus gzhan gyis grogs byar med/ /grogs bgyir mchis na thugs rje che mnga' yis/ /sems can gcig kyang ma lus bsgral bar rigs/ /de bas bla ma'i brda tsam mtshon pa yis/ /rang gis rang gi sems la legs par gzigs/ /mthong ba med na sems nyid mthong ba yin/ /mthong bya mthong byed med par dgongs pa long*/ /de yi ngang la gnas na sgom pa'i mchog /'gro ba gcig la sems rgyud gnyis mi 'char/ /gcig pur rang sems rang mi mthong bar 'gyur/ /mthong bar gyur kyang de nyid med/ /ma bcos bcos med ngang du bzhag /tshogs chen rnam gnyis rdzogs pa ni/ /sems nyid ma bcos gnyug ma yin/ /rnam rtog rang sar grol ba ni/ /sems nyid don la spyod pa yin/ / dgongs pa yul dang bral tsa na/ /de ni mthong ba'i lam yin no/ /yul sems gnyis med ngang gnas na/ /mi bsgoms bsgom pa'i lam yin no/

/sems la 'khor 'das gnyis med pas/ /mthar phyin bar chad med pa'i lam/ /lam lnga byang chub sems yin pas/ /byang chub sems la goms par bya/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ yid ches 'bral med kyi le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ gdul bya rang du bstan pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /'jig rten gnyen dang bshes spong la/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rtag tu bsten/ /de ni skye gnas kun gyi gnyen/ / gnyen dang bshes rnams kun spangs nas/ /gcig pu gshed dang 'grogs dgos pas/ /mdza' dang mi mdza' kun ci rung*/ /cho nges btab kyang lta nyan bsam pa med/ /rang nyid las kyis ded pas bred gyur na/ /de bas yun gyi so nam bya bar gsungs/ /nya pa zhing pa gdol pa nor med pas/ /da lta'i 'tsho ba tsam gcig sems pa yang*/ /grang dang tsha ba la sogs bzod byed na/ /gtan gyi bde phyir dge chos cis mi mdzad/ /ngan song gnas la 'jigs skrag med pa ni// de ni bdud kyi byin rlabs yin par gsungs/ /mi dge rgyu la mi 'dzem glen pa de/ /'bras bu ngan song spong bas mi spangs so/ /chos kyi mchog ni rang sems dul ba yin/ /bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gnad kyis ni/ /sems kyi glang po skye med dam la thogs/ /rang gis rang skyong bde chen gnas su skyong*/ /tshor ba bde sdug mtshan ma rang sar grol/ /de ltar gnas pa skyes bu mdo can la/ / 'jigs pa gang yang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sems 'di khong nas thul ba yis/ /gnod byed thams cad thul ba yin/ /sems can mi bsrungs bsam mi khyab/ /de dag gdul gyi ga na lang*/ khros pa'i sems 'di gcig bcom na/ / dgra ni thams cad chom dang 'dra/ /zhe sdang sems la bcangs na dgra la zad dus med/ /de bas zhe sdang byung sa blta bar bya/ /e ma sa steng 'di kun ko g.yog tu/ /de snyed ko bas ga na lang*/ /rkang mthil gang gis ko bas ni/

/de snyed ko bas g.yogs dang 'dra/ /de phyir phyi rol dngos po yang*/ /bdag gis phyi rol bzlog mi langs/ /gzung 'dzin sems 'di phyir bzlog byar/ /gzhan rnams bzlog go ci zhig dgos/ /chos rnams kun gyi don po mchog /sems kyi gsang 'di shes par gyis/ /sems kyi gsang 'di ma shes na/ /bde 'dod sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod kyang*/ /de dag don med gyi nar 'khyams/ /de lta bas na bdag nyid kyi/ /sems 'di legs gzung rtogs par gyis/ /mi bsams pa la bsam byas na/ /bsam pa nyid ni bdud du 'gyur/ /bsam med dgongs pa sus lon pa/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ rang gdul byar bstan pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las sman sbyor dgos pa 'di gsungs so/ /skye ba mi lus mtshon gyis ni/ /rma byung ljibs kyis 'tsho bar byed// rnal 'byor sems la rtogs pa yis/ /rma byung mnyam nyid gnas pas gso/ /skye bo lus la dgra byung na/ /stobs ldan mtshon gyis phyi ru bzlog /rnal 'byor chos la dgra byung na/ /rtogs ldan nyams kyis nang du bzlog /skye bo 'chi bas 'jigs pa ni/ /sman dang mo bon cho gas blu/ /rnal 'byor 'chi bas 'jigs pa ni/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sems la blta/ /skye bo 'tsho bas nyen pa ni/ /tshong dang so nam rku 'phrog dag gis gso/ /rnal 'byor 'tsho bas nyen pa ni/ /dka' thub ldom bu ting 'dzin zas/ /'tsho ba dag la brten par bya/ /rtse gcig ting 'dzin bsgom par bya/ /de nyid kho na sgrub pa'i mchog khye chung sems can snyags pa lam/ /lha khang bar gyi sprang po bzhin/ /gnyis 'dzin yul phyir 'brangs pa yis/ /dgos 'dod gcig shos mi 'grub bo/ /bran g.yog bkol du mi btub pa/ /zas la sogs pa mi byin ltar/ /dge ba mi byed lus 'di la/ /zas skom bsnyod kyang sdug bsngal snon/

/sdig lus bsnyod cing gos bskon yang*/ /phan med sdug lus ci ste gso/ khyod ma 'grangs pas sdug bsngal phung mgo btsugs// dkon mchog pha ma dga' mdza' dang*/ /drin yod drin med sdig la 'bags pa'i nor/ /sgyus rku mthus phrogs thabs kyis bslu/ /de ltar byas kyang sdig lus khyod ma sos/ /rnam grangs mang pos sdig lus khyod/ /ma sos pa yis rku 'phrog byas/ /mjug tu 'bu sbrang snyod mar song*/ khyod ma sos pas srog gcod byas/ / dmyal ba'i gnas su khyod kyis btang*/ khyod ma sos pas rku 'phrog byas/ /yi dwags gnas su khyod kyis btang*/ khyod ma sos pas chos ma dran/ /dge bshes dge 'dun ma bsten pas/ /dud 'gro'i gnas su khyod kyis btang*/ /'khor bar 'khyams pa khyod kyis lan/ /sgyu ma'i lus khyod tshur nyon dang*/ khyod ni dge ba spyod gyur na/ /mi lus rin chen phangs pa'i gtso/ khyod la brten nas sangs rgyas chos/ /'bras bu bla med byang chub dang*/ /bar du'ang bde 'gro bskyed pa yi/ /lung btags don yod byed pa yis/ /'gro don 'ong ba'i rten tsam du/ / lus la gru yi blo bzhag ste/ /'di la zas ni byin nas ni/ /de ni rang don byed du chug /ces byas pas slar lus kyi smras pa/ rmongs pa'i sems khyod ci zer na/ / gzugs su 'dzin pa khyod rang yin/ /lus su lta ba khyod rang yin/ /don med shes pas gzhan nas 'ong*/ /'byung ba bsrubs pa'i khu khrag las/ khyod kyis ngar 'dzin byas nas ni/ /bu dang bu mor khyod kyis gzung*/ /gzhan gyi 'byung ba'i khu khrag las/ /gzhan zhes dgra ru khyod kyis gzung*/ /sdig pas bsgrubs pa'i nor rdzas la/ /gzhan gyis khyer snyam phrag dog byas/ /don med byis pa'i spyod pa 'dra/ /ces byas pas/ sems kyis smras pa/ 'byung ba'i lus 'di ci zer na/ /nga yi khyod gnyer ma byas nas/ /nga ni 'byung ba bag la zha/ /nga ma gso bar khyod bder 'dug

/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ 'dod pa'i sman sbyor lam gyi le'u ste bcu pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ zhal ta'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /kun gyi bshes gnyen 'di gsungs so/ /deng bya sang bya'i le lo phyi bshol can/ /sngon 'das dus na da rung 'gyangs pas chog /'chi bdag bdud dang bang bya brtod nas ni/ /dam chos myur du bya bar mi rigs sam/ /skra dkar skyes shing gnyer ma'i tshogs 'dus kyang*/ /don med gyi nar 'khyams pa ma tshor ram/ /byis pa shed ma bye ba 'dra ba ni/ /don la mkhas pas bltas na snying re rje/ /rten 'brel las byung 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di/ /phung po kho nas ma byas sems ma byas/ khyed gnyis bsdongs nas 'khor ba bsgrubs pa yin/ / ci phyir zhe na 'di ltar dgongs mdzod dang*/ /sems med lus po snang ba su la snang*/ /lus snang med la sems snang ci la snang*/ /lus kyis sems gzung sems kyis lus gzung bas/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis ra bar chud pa yin/ / khyed gnyis 'dus pas bag chags bsags/ /bag chags bzang dang ngan gnyis las/ /mtho ris ngan song 'byung ba yin/ /bder snang sdug snang bsam mi khyab/ /gcig gis ma lan 'dus pas lan/ /kye ma lus gtsang thob pa rnams/ /gal te bcos su yod pa na/ /de la mi dga' bya ci dgos/ /gal te bcos su med pa na/ /de la mi dga' byas ci phan/ /'khor ba'i rten 'brel 'jig dus su/ /dge la dad pa byas pa yis/ /ngan song rten 'brel 'jig par 'gyur/ /skye ba med pa'i don bsgoms na/ /bsam du med pa'i dgongs pa 'char/ /ma bsam lus sems 'brel med pas/ /'khor ba'i rten 'brel 'jig par 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i rten 'brel zhig pa las/ /mya ngan 'das par gsungs pa yin/ /de bas bcos su yod pa yin/ /bcos su med pa tsa na yod//

de ltar dgongs dang rigs kyi bu/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub par 'dod pa dang*/ /mi chos bya ba gnyis mi 'khrugs/ /sbyin pa gtong bar 'dod pa dang*/ /zad kyis dogs pa gnyis mi 'khrugs/ /dpa' bor bya bar 'dod pa dang*/ /shi bar dogs pa gnyis mi 'khrugs/ /kun gyis bkur bar 'dod pa dang*/ /spyod lam ngan pa gnyis mi 'khrugs/ /stong nyid bsgom par bya ba dang*/ /dngos po'i 'dzin pa gnyis mi 'khrugs/ /sgrib gnyis byang bar 'dod pa dang*/ /zog po bsten pa gnyis mi 'khrugs/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'jug pa las nyams myong zhal ta'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ yid rton du mi rung ba'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /mi rtag rgyud la skye dgos te/ /mi rtag rgyud la ma skyes na/ /long med rgyud la mi skye ste/ /don med le lo'i dbang song nas/ / dal 'byor chud zos shin tu phongs/ /tshe ni gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi/ / chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na/ /dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis log pa las/ /tshe zad pa ni gang gis ma tshor bar/ /lus la mtha' med thal ba rdul bzhin brlag /mtha' mar lus la snying po ma mchis na/ /so sor gyes pa'i chos can yin rigs bya/ /mi lus rin chen thob dka' bas/ /rgya mtsho gcig na gnya' shing bu ga dang*/ /rus sbal phrad pa bas kyang dud 'gro las/ /mi lus 'thob pa shin tu dka'/ /dam chos spyad pa de kha ma yin pas/ /mtha' ma bsnyen gnas tsam la gnas par mdzod/ /rin chen snod du ngan skyugs blugs pa shin tu blun/ /mi lus rin chen snod na sdig pa spyod pa de bzhin blun/ /'dam nas padma byung ba'i padma la/ /sbrang rtsi byung ba ngo mtshar che/ /de yang bung bas myong ba las/ /sbal pa la sogs gzhan mi shes/ /sha khrag las byung mi lus las/ / sangs rgyas 'byung ba ngo mtshar che/ /dad pa can gyi rtogs pa las/

/rmongs pa spal 'dras rtogs mi 'gyur/ /de phyir mnyam snyoms ma mdzad par/ /mnyam nyid ngang la gnas par mdzod/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /de ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lhag pa shes rab bslab pa ni/ /sems nyid stong pa nyid du slobs/ / sems nyid stong pa nyid gnas na/ /dngos snang zhen pa bags kyis ldog /lhag pa'i tshul khrims bslab pa ni/ /rig pa 'du byed med pa ste/ /yul dang sems gnyis 'dus ma byas/ /gzung 'dzin med par gnas par gyur/ /lhag pa'i sems kyi bslab pa ni/ /snang stong gang la mi gnas par/ /rtag chad mtha' las grol gyur na/ /spros bral dgongs pa thob par 'gyur/ /bslab pa gsum la gnas pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yin/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ yid rton du mi rung ba'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ legs par mdzad pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /dam pa'i chos dang chos smra la/ /nyid kyis bkur sti'i mchog dang ni/ /gus par mdzad dang gdan las bzhengs/ /me tog gtor nas chos mnyan cing*/ /shes par bslabs pa gzhan la bshad/ /bsten pa'i snying po dam pa la/ /'jig rten gtam la dga' ma mdzad/ /'jig rten 'das la dgyes par mdzod/ /'khor rnams zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir/ /lhun la lhun rtag nges par mdzod/ /bka' lung gzhung lugs bzhin du gsung*/ / snyan khung mi sdug pa dang ni/ /bud med chags phyir sems la g.yeng*/ /srab chos byis pa ltar ma mdzad/ /cung tsam gyis ni dgyes gyur nas/ /cung zad kyis ni khro ma mdzad/ /grub bam mi 'grub ma nges par/ /dran ma thag tu ma gsungs shig/ mi chos chab srid mi 'grub cing*/ /ser sna 'jur 'gegs ma mdzad par/ / bdog pa thams cad tshogs su thong*/ khyod ni bdog pa kun bor nas/ /gcig pu ga shed gshegs 'tshal bas/

/chos kyi slad du spyad pa kun/ khyod kyi mdun du 'ong ba nyid/ /de bas dgongs la dad par bya/ /ngang dang rang bzhin bdag nyid bsgom/ /ngang ni lus ngag ma bcos par/ /so ma gnas pa nyid la bya/ /rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa ste/ /byang chub sems la 'gyur ba med/ /bdag nyid lhun gyis grub pa ste/ /sems med sems las lhun gyis grub/ /bdag nyid yin pa'i gtan tshigs go /sdig pa'i blo sems mi gnas na/ /mi gnas gnas pa'i dang po yin/ /dge ba'i blo sems mi gnas na/ /mi gnas gnas pa gnyis pa yin/ /dge sdig gnyis la mi gnas na/ /mi gnas gnas pa'i mchog yin no/ /'byung ba nam mkha'i khams las ma gtogs pa'i/ /'ja' tshon sna lnga gud nas 'byung gnas med/ /chos nyid byang chub sems las ma gtogs pa'i/ /dug lnga dug gsum gud nas byung ba med/ /'byung lnga dug lnga ci byung ci shar yang*/ / rang byung rang zhi rtogs ldan sems su zhi/ /zhi zhing gnas na zhi gnas sgom yin te/ /byung tshul ngo bo stong pa lhag mthong yin/ /zhi gnas zung du chud pa bde legs yin/ /lus nyal bzhin du sems kyang nyol/ /gnyid log mnyam nyid tshul du log /byang chub sems dpa'i nyal lugs yin/ /lus lang bzhin du sems kyang longs/ /rjes thob sgyu ma lta bur longs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ldang lugs yin/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ legs par mdzad pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ snang ba grogs su bstan pa 'di gsungs so/ /byang chub spyod pa'i gang zag la/ /rkyen ngan grogs su bsgyur ba las/ /bdud du song ba rnam gnyis so/ /rkyen ngan la ni skyo ba skyes// chos la tshud na grogs su song*/ /rkyen ngan rnam par rtog pa yi/ /rtsa ba mthong bas rang bzhin med/ /dper na 'khyags mthong chur shes bzhin/ /de ltar shes na grogs su gsungs/ /rnam par rtog pas kun bslangs nas/

/gzung 'dzin sdig pa'i las la spyod/ /rnam smin ngan song gsum du smin/ /de ni bdud du song ba'o/ /'jig rten phun sum tshogs pa la/ /snying rje'i 'du shes bsgom pa ni/ / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yin/ /ci phyir gang gis snying rje na/ /'dir sdug bsngal sna tshogs skyes pas kyang snying rje/ sems kyi 'khrul ba las yang dag par gzung bas de snying rje/ 'chi khar mi gtong bas de snying rje/ shi nas ngan song du skye bas kyang snying rje'o/ /spyir 'gro ba gzhan gyi 'khrul ba la mi brtags pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam 'phrul yin srid pas kyang 'khrul ba la mi brtag /thabs kyi dge ba la 'dzud pa yin srid pas kyang gzhan gyi 'khrul ba la mi brtag go /gtso cher rang gi snang ba ma dag pa yin srid pas kyang gzhan gyi 'khrul ba la mi brtag go /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang ma 'dres pa'i spyod pa bya/ nyan thos ni dmigs pa dang bcas shing mchog 'dod pa las gol ba'o/ /'dus ma byas su 'dod pas mthar lhung la/ de ltar ma yin par byang sems spyod pa ni/ dge ba ci byed pa dam pa gsum gyis zin par byas la btang*/ lung du ma bstan pa'i bzo dang so nam thams cad kyang*/ byang chub tu bsngo bar bya ba dang*/ las kyi bsags pa bgrangs shing bshags pa bya ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med par bsngo ba'o/ /dam pa gsum ni sbyor ba dam pa stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ dngos gzhi pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan/ 'jug 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'o/ /yang na gtong ba dam pa ser sna med pa/ dngos po dam pa yid du 'ong ba/ bsngo ba dam pa dmigs pa med par bsngo ba'o// yang na gtong ba dam pa snang srid blo yis btang*/ /dngos po dam pa dngos min gzhi la bzhag /dmigs pa dam pa yul med rang sar gnas/ /dngos po gang la ma chags na/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa yin/ /dngos bral ngang la gnas pa ni/

/tshul khrims pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ /byung tshor rtog pa mi 'gegs pa/ / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ /'gyur ba rang log skad cig grol/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa yin/ /gcig las mi 'da' don rtogs na/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa yin/ /shes bya yul las 'das pa ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa yin/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ snang ba grogs su bsgyur ba'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ tshad med ngos 'dzin dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /bdag gzhan byang chub thob 'dod pas/ /tshad med bzhi la 'jug par bya/ khams gsum sems can thams cad ni/ /bde ba 'ba' zhig 'dod pa las/ /sdug bsngal 'dod pa med na yang*/ /bde ba bsgrubs pas sdug bsngal 'grub/ /de la snying rje tshad med bsgom/ /sdug bsngal de dang bral bar bsgom/ /de ni byams pa tshad med yin/ /de dang bral na bde bar smon/ /de ni dga' ba tshad med yin/ /bde chen 'du 'bral med par smon// de ni btang snyoms tshad med yin/ /bdag yod bdag med rnam gnyis las/ / dang por bdag med bstan gyur na/ /stong nyid don dam mi ldan par/ /kun rdzob bde ba khyad bsad nas/ /chad pa'i mtha' la mngon zhen pas/ /stong pa'i bdag po stong par 'gro /dang po bdag yod bstan pas ni/ /bdag la gces pa'i bsam pa yis/ /bde na dga' la sdug mi dga'/ /bde ba'i rgyu ni dge ba la/ / sdug bsngal mi dge sdig las byung*/ /bde ba dga' ba bde ba spyod/ /sdug na mi dga'i blo yod pas/ /sdig pa spong bar 'gyur ba yin/ /sdig spangs dge ba rdzogs pa la/ /stong nyid bdag med bstan par bya/ /rig stong rtsa ba med pa las/ /rtsa ba med pa don rtogs nas/ /dran pa rtsa bral ngang gnas na/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa gzhi la dag /rnam par rtog pa rang sar grol/ /rjes la bdag tu snang yod kyang*/ /ltar snang tsam las gzhi ma grub/

/de ltar mnyam bzhag rjes thob las/ /bdag med dgongs pa mngon du gyur/ /sku gsum 'bras bu lhun gyis grub/ /tshad med spyod pas 'gro don 'byung*/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ tshad med ngos 'dzin gyi le'u ste bco lnga pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /mtshams med sdig pa spyad na dmyal bar skye/ / rang sdug rang gis nyos so rang gros thob/ khas blangs tshul khrims 'chal na dud 'gror skye/ /thar lam rang srog ma gcod rang gros thob/ /dag pa'i smon lam ma thebs mtha' 'khob skye/ /'du shes phyin ci log go rang gros thob/ /lhag pa'i shes rab chung bas kla klor skye/ /thos pa'i shes rab bskyed cig dad ldan kun/ / dkon mchog gsum la ma dad log lta 'byung*/ /mos gus gting nas gyis shig dad pa can/ /kun gzhi ma bcos gnas lugs la/ /sems nyid ma bcos rang bzhag nas/ /chu la chu bzhag nyid du mtshungs/ /sgom lugs bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /bsgom bya sgom byed ma dmigs na/ /sgom pa kun gyi mthar thug yin/ /de yang ci lta bu zhe na/ dmigs pa'i yul dang mtshan ma'i mtha' las 'das/ /tha snyad brjod bral yod med mtha' las grol/ /mi bsgoms pa ni sgom pa chen po lags/ /sgom du med pa de yin ngo mtshar che/ /re zhig bsgoms na ji ltar bsgom par bya/ /zhes pas/ phyi bsdus nang glod sems nyid brtan por zhog /de yang ci lta bu zhe na/ snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa'i chos/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan med pas/ /de ni phyi bsdus zhes su brjod/ /sems la gzung 'dzin gnyis med pas/ /nang glod zhes ni de la bya/ /gzung 'dzin med par goms pa la/ /brtan pa zhes kyang de la bya/ /mi bsgoms sgom pa'i nyams brtan pas/ /gar yang ma btsal lhun gyis grub/ /bde ba chen po'i klong na gnas/ / mi 'gyur kha dog dbyibs dang bral/

/spyir yang mi snang rdul tsam med/ /rkyen skyes dran pa rang sar grol/ /rang dgar zhen pa'i 'dzin pa spangs/ /gang ltar byas kyang bde ba nyid/ /gzhan don rtsol ba ma byas kyang*/ /byin rlabs 'bad pa med par 'byung*/ /yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'chang*/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ sgrib pa gnyis spangs pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ skyon yon bstan pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /rgyu rkyen byas pas chos la blo ltos med/ /skye dang rga dang na dang 'chi ba'i slad/ /de yang ji ltar yin zhe na/ /skye ba'i sdug bsngal 'di ltar gda'/ /rig pa las kyis bda' bda' bas/ khu khrag 'dres pa'i klong du zhugs/ /nur nur po dang ltar ltar po/ /'khrang gyur yan lag lnga la sogs// lnga lnga po rnams dod tsam na/ /ma ni 'grangs te brag bar btsir ba 'dra/ /ltogs pa'i tshe na dpyangs la btang ba 'dra/ /tsha 'thung grang 'thung sdug bsngal bzod thabs med/ /nyal ba'i tshe na ri yis mnan pa 'dra/ /drag shul byed tshe brdung rdzogs byed pa 'dra/ /btsas pa'i tshe na pags pa bshus pa 'dra/ /rtsig pa'i ngos la drud pa bas kyang sdug /lhung ba'i tshe na tsher phung lhung ba 'dra/ /blangs pa'i tshe na byis phrug khras khyer 'dra/ /bkres skom tshigs bu rkang lag na nas sdug /cher skyes na yang so nam brel phongs sdug /skye ba'i sdug bsngal de ltar ro/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal 'di ltar yin/ /mgo dkar gnyer 'du rkang lag 'dar/ kha sna chu brub gzhan gyis mthong mi 'dod/ /yar ldang mar sdod thel phur tsha ba'i tshul// bu tsha kun kyang shi na rung snyam sems/ /de ltar shes shing shi 'dod shir ma btub/ / shi ba'i 'dre yang nga la med do zer/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal de ltar yin/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal 'di ltar yin/ /'byung bzhi tsha grang ma snyoms dang*/ /gnod sbyin pho mo'i khu ldog dang*/

/zas dang spyod lam rtsing ba yis/ /na ba'i blo rkyen byung tsa na/ /mdzes pa'i gzi mdangs shor bas yi dwags 'dra/ /lus kyi nyams stobs shor bas ldang mi nus/ /bza' bcas srog 'dzin yin te drir mi 'gro / na mtha' 'chi ba yin pas zhe la 'jigs/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal de ltar yin/ / da 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal 'di ltar yin/ /gnyen bshes mang pos mtha' bskor yang*/ /de la nyan dang lta bsam yul yang med/ /mtha' bzhi bskor zhing sdug bsngal rab tu che/ /bar do na yang lhung ngam bsams pas 'jigs/ /dge sdig bya ra lag pa g.yas g.yon khrid/ /gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i spyan sngar phyin/ / las kyi me long mdun du phyar ba yis/ /gal te sdig pa'i las kyi ngan song du/ / skye bar mthong nas chos rgyal 'di skad du/ /ngas ni 'di la lan pa ci yang med/ / rang gi las ngan rang la smin pa yin/ khyod rang bka' bzhin ma byas da 'gyod dam/ /de bas dmyal ba'i gnas su khrid de thal/ /kyi hud kyi hud byas kyang mgon skyabs med/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal de ltar gda'o kye/ /e ma ho/ de bas de ltar rang sems gtan la phob/ /sems kyi sems nyid med rtogs na/ /de bas 'byung ba'i dug lnga rtsa ba med/ /dug lnga rtsa med mtshan ma rang sar grol/ / grol ba'i ngang la yang yang gnas gyur na/ /de las 'ong ba'i 'gro drug rtsa ba med/ /'gro drug rtsa med sdug bsngal spangs pa las/ /sangs rgyas zhes ni ming du brjod pa lags/ /mi lus thob la khe nyen de yod pas/ /rang gis rang la bzhengs bskul thob cig kye/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las skyon yon bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o//

//byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ ye shes rang gsal gyi dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ khams gsum me ltar 'bar ba'i khang pa na/ /sdug bsngal me ltar 'bar ba'i me bo che/ /da lta rang gi khams su ma bsad na/ /phyis ni rang la rang gis gsod par dka'/ /bzang 'khor ngan 'khor gang 'khor ba'i/ /lam sna mi lus sems kyi zung*/ /da lta sems la ma nor zung*/ /mi shes mkhyen pa can la dris/ /phyis ni lam sna rnyed par dka'/ /rta kha srab kyis bsgyur ba bzhin/ /ma bde ba yi lam ched du/ /rang gi kha lo rang gis bsgyur/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnams kyis/ /lam sna sems la zug pas na/ /nor bu rin chen de na yod/ /sku gsum 'bras bu de na yod/ /de nyid bsgoms na ji ltar sgom/ /bsgom bya sgom byed ma mchis kyang*/ /re zhig bsgoms na 'di ltar bsgom/ /bsgom bya'i yul ni phar mi snang*/ /sgom snyam shes su tshur mi 'jug / sems kyis sems btsal sgom pa ni/ /bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis yod pas/ / gol sa yin par mkhas pas gsungs/ /ji bzhin bcos pa med pa'i kun gzhi la/ /de bzhin 'chos pa med pa'i sems nyid bzhag /de la ma yengs yun du bzhag lags na/ /rang shar rig pa nang nas 'char bar 'gyur/ /brjod du med pa'i man ngag gnad dang bcas/ /bsam du med pa'i ye shes nyams dang bcas/ /sgom du med pa'i sems nyid don dang bcas/ /bsrung du med pa'i dam tshig grogs dang bcas/ /spyad du med pa'i spyod pa shugs dang bcas/ /bsgrub du med pa'i 'bras bu sku dang bcas/ /'o na bsgom bya med pa kho na'am/ /zhes pas/ ma bsgoms par sangs rgyas par ni gang nas kyang ma gsungs pas bsgom dgos/ 'o na sems sgom mam lus sgom/ sems bsgoms na sems dmigs pa'i yul dang bral/ mtshan ma'i mtha' ni 'das/ /brjod pa'i tha snyad dang ni bral/ /bsgoms kyang skye ba med pa'i ngang*/ /des nas sems la sgom du med

do/ /lus bsgoms na lus byung ba bzhin/ lus 'byung ba bzhi bag la zha ste/ 'byung bzhi ye nas rtog bral yin/ de bas lus la sgom du med do/ /'o na ci bsgoms na/ bag chags rnyed par byed pa'i nyon mongs pa'i yid kyi rang bzhin bsgom/ nyon mongs pa'i yid mi bsgom du byung tshor 'jug byed mkhan nyon mongs pa yin pas/ nyon mongs pa'i yid la yid kyis bltas pas ma rnyed/ ma rnyed pa'i ngang la bzhag pas nyon mongs pa chos nyid du sgom pa'o/ /nyon mongs pa chos nyid du bsgoms pas/ bag chags zhi ste rten dang bral/ de ltar rtogs pas 'khor bar mi skye'o/ /ma skyes mi skye ba'i rig pa 'gyu ba yang*/ las dbang mi 'gro ye shes chen po yin/ /ye shes rang la rnyed pa'i skyes bu dam pa de/ /long bas nor bu rin chen rnyed ces bya/ /'khrul thag chod pa ces kyang de la bya/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ ye shes rang snang gi le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ sbyin mchod gso sbyong gi dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /mchod sbyin gso sbyong mthong gyur pas/ /phyi ltar dkon mchog gsum la mchod/ /nang ltar bla ma yi dam mchod/ /gsang ba rang gi sems nyid mchod/ /phyi ltar snying rje'i mgron la sbyin/ /nang ltar lan chags mgron la sbyin/ /gsang ba byang chub sems la sbyin/ /lus kyis lus kyi dge ba gso/ /ngag gis ngag gi dge ba gso/ /yid kyis yid kyi dge ba gso/ / dge ba tshul bzhin gsos pa yis/ /lus ngag sgrib pa ngang gis byang*/ /dper na sha bur sman gso na/ khrag rnag shugs kyis 'chad bzhin no/ /mi mthong sems can ma mthong sems mi mthong*/ /sems nyid mi mthong mthong med pa/ /de ni don dam yang dag mthong*/ /ma mthong ba de mthong ba'i mchog /ma mthong lta ba goms gyur na/ /dngos snang 'dzin pa chung bar 'gyur/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis las grol pa la/

/mngon du gyur ces gsungs pa yin/ /nyin dang mtshan du yang dang yang*/ /yan lag bdun pa'i dge sbyor brtson/ /thun mong gnas pa'i gso sbyong yin/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bsgom pa yin/ khyad par gnas pa'i gso sbyong yin/ /bdag gzhan gnyis su med pa yi/ /spros bral ngang la gnas pa ni// thun mong ma yin gso sbyong yin/ /dge ba gso zhing sdig pa sbyong*/ /yar la mchod cing mar la sbyin/ /byang chub sems mthong mngon gyur na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yin/ /bdag nyid sems can don la gnas/ /snying rje phan sems bsgom pa ni/ /rgyu yi byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /bdag dang sems can gnyis la gnas/ /ma bcos sems la yongs rdzogs pa/ /'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /kun rdzob don dang don dam bden/ /gcig la gcig ltos ma yin par/ /ltos pa zad pa bden rdzun med/ /bden rdzun gnyis las 'das pa na/ /don dam bden zhes mtshon pa yin/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ mchod sbyin gso sbyong gnas pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'jug pa las/ snang srid 'khrul bar bstan pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams sems kyi 'khrul ba ste/ / sems las ma gtogs chos rnams med/ /'khrul snang med pa'i chos rnams la// bden par gzung bas 'khyams pa yin/ /smig rgyu'i chu dang skra shad 'dzin/ /thi gu sbrul dang rmi lam yul/ /med bzhin snang 'di chos can yin/ /'khor ba'i sems can de bzhin yin/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal yang*/ /med bzhin snang ba'i sems la btags/ /sangs rgyas yon tan phun tshogs kyang*/ /sgyu ma bzhin du rang bzhin med/ /de bas 'khor 'das ma lus kun/ /'khrul ba yin par bka' nas gsungs/ /'khrul bar shes pa'i skyes bu ni/ /snang tsam nyid las med rtogs pas/ /las dang rnam smin gsog mi 'gyur/ /rta la skyes pa'i rta nyid du/

/'byung 'gyur 'ong sogs gzhan mi 'byung*/ /skye med las skyes skyes med nyid/ /gzhan du 'gyur ba yod ma yin/ /rtog pa rang dgar 'dzin pa'i mis/ / mi rtog bsgoms kyang rtog par 'gyur/ /dper na grang ba can dag gis/ /sman mchog ga bur zos gyur kyang*/ /dug tu 'gyur ba ji bzhin no/ /de bas rtogs pa shin tu gces/ /rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pa la/ /ma nor bla ma gces pa yin/ / de bas ma nor bla ma btsal/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun bas lhag /ci phyir zhe na mkhas rtags de las 'byung*/ /mkhas pa bya ba mkhas pa min/ /tshig la mkhas pas mkhas pa min/ /don la mkhas na mkhas pa yin/ /sangs rgyas bya ba sangs rgyas min/ /gzung 'dzin spangs na sangs rgyas yin/ /bde ba bya ba bde ba min/ /sdug bsngal spangs na bde ba yin/ /rten 'brel tshogs na sgyu mas kyang*/ /bya ba sna tshogs nus par 'gyur/ / rten 'brel zhig na nus pa med/ /'khor ba'i rten 'brel de bzhin mtshungs/ / lus sems gcig la gcig brten pas/ /chags sdang 'brel ba 'byung ba yin// de las 'khor ba sna tshogs 'byung*/ /sgyu ma'i skyes pa bu med kyang*/ /sems med sems la mi lta'o/ /de bas sgyu ma skye mi brgyud/ /de bzhin yang dag don bsgoms pas/ /sems med sems la ma lta zhig /yul la bde bar ma 'dzin cig /'dzin med yul las grol ba na/ /'khor ba'i rten 'brel zhig pa yin/ / skye rga na 'chi'i nus pa med/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ snang srid 'khrul bar bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ sgom thabs bstan pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gnas khang du/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /dang po 'jug pa la mkhas pa/ /bar du gnas pa la mkhas pa/ /mtha' ma ldang ba la mkhas pa'o/ /dang po ni gang zag rang gis rang la/ gzhan la gnas pa med par/

rbab chen lung du tshud pa bzhin/ mi bsam par cog ge bzhag go /bar du bzhag pa la mkhas pa ni/ mthong ba'i yul la sems bzhag kyang mi bzhag /tshur bzlog kyang mi bzlog par rang lugs su bzhag go /mtha' ma ldang ba la mkhas pa ni/ nga rtog pa 'gyus kyang byang chub sems las ma 'das par 'dug gis/ rang byung rang grol du 'dug pas sgom dang ma bral bar shes par byas la ldang ba'o/ /dbang po 'bring gis dang po 'jug pa ni/ dbang po 'du ba'i gnas sna rtser mig dang yid gtad la/ khong lhod de rang lugs su bzhag go /bar du gnas pa ni sa le sing nge dang bar bzhag go /ldang ba ni rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du shes par byas la ldang ngo*/ /dbang po tha ma ni/ dang por rang gi yid du 'ong ba gcig la sems gzung la bzhag /de la rig pa zin nas mi 'phro bar 'dug tsa na zin pa yin/ bar du gnas pa ni/ ltem me re re gnas pa'i yun mi ring tsam sgom pa la/ ldang ba ni sgom 'phro la langs nas/ rjes la lus ngag gi dge sbyor la gzhug go /dper na rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin shes pa gcig gis rlabs ci byung chur ngo shes so/ /de ltar shes pa'i gang zag de la/ dang por sgom pa la 'jug pa dang*/ bar du gnas pa dang*/ mtha' mar ldang ba dang*/ 'grig dang rim pa dang*/ thun mtshams med do zhes/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ sgom thabs bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer gcig pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ sgom bstan tshad kyi dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /mig mi btsum pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /rnal 'byor kun las khyad par 'phags/ /seng ge'i lta stangs zhes kyang brjod/ /mig phye btsum med par thang nge ba/ /snang ba la rtsis gdab med par wal le ba/ /dus 'da' nus pa yid nan che/ /brjed ngas med la mtshan ma med pa'i bsgom bstan pa'o/ /mtshan bcas la bstan pa ni/ hūm̐ lta bu gcig la rig pa gtad cing bsgom pas rig pa zin pa dang*/ hūm̐ de gnyis sam gsum la rig pa gzung*/

brgya dang stong la rig pa gzung*/ de brtan pa dang*/ mig btsum pas gsal mi gsal 'ong ngam mi 'ong lta/ mig phye nas bltas pa dang*/ btsum nas bltas pa la khyad par mi 'dug na brtan pa yin/ rig pa las su rung ba yin te/ rig pa gang gtad gtad nus pa 'byung ba yin/ nyon mongs pa skyes kyang*/ skyes pa de rang la gtad pas/ chos nyid du skad cig la nyal nyal 'gro ba yin/ bzhag na gar bzhag tu sdod pa ni brtan pa yin no/ /brtan pa bogs dbyung ba ni/ phyogs su lham bu bya ba'am/ /las dang bya ba ci byed kyang*/ /'phel 'grib med par 'dug pas na/ /de ni brtan pa'i bogs yin no/ /de ltar nyams dang ldan tsa na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yin/ /thugs rje'i stobs kyis gzhan don 'byung*/ /rtogs pa'i stobs kyis rang don 'grub/ /rang don spros bral chos sku thob/ /gzhan don gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'byung*/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ sgom thob pa'i le'u ste nyer gnyis pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ mi 'da' ba'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal pos khrims chen bcas pa la/ /'bangs rnams kun gyis de las 'da' mi nus/ /rgya las 'das na chad pas gcod/ /sems nyid skye med rgyal khrims las/ /rnam rtog 'bangs kyis 'da' mi nus/ /rgya las 'das na chad pas gcod/ /rgya mtsho mnyam par gnas pa la/ /chu bur gnyer mas 'da' mi nus/ /mnyam nyid bsgoms pas gnas pa la/ /byung tshor gya gyur 'da' mi nus/ /shing las me 'bar shing rang sreg pa ltar/ /rtog pa rang grol de bzhin nyid du bas/ /sha khrag lus kyi dur khrod na/ /snang med sems kyi sgom chen bzhugs/ /su yi mchod gnas ma yin rang gi yin/ /rang gi mchod gnas rang gis ltos/ /snang ngam mi snang nges par gzigs/ /sgom chen byang chub sems dpa' de/ /dran pa sna tshogs zas su dran/ /dran pa med pa gos su gyon//

skye ba med pa'i gzim mal na/ /blo 'das ro nyal nyid du gzims/ /gti mug nam langs mun pa sangs/ /sgom chen bde ba chen por bzhengs/ /mi snang sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /sgom chen zhal mthong de ltar mthong*/ /grub thob de yi zhal mthong bas/ /bdag kyang sgrib pa byang gyur nas/ /skye med dbyings la rnam par gnas/ /mtha' bral dgongs pa rang la tshang*/ /da yang lta yang mi lta'o/ / nyag gcig dmigs pa yul med pas/ /da yang sgom yang mi sgom mo/ /skye med ye nas rang gnas pas/ /da yang sgrub yang mi sgrub bo/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ mi 'da' ba'i le'u ste nyer gsum pa'o// // byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ 'bad pa don ldan gyi dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /tshe gcig rings pa gang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ / ci tsam sdig dang 'grogs nas nor bsags kyang*/ /bsags pa'i nor rdzas bu tshas 'khyer/ /de yi rnam smin pha ma rgan rgon khur/ khur rgyu de yis dmyal ba'i rgyags phye byas/ /chos mi spyod kyi rgyu 'bras de 'dra na/ /de bas rang gis rang la gros thob la/ /mi lus 'dom pa gang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bka' dang bsdongs nas dam chos rgyas mdzad pas/ /gzung 'dzin mdud pa sbrul mdud bzhin du grol/ /sku gsum 'bras bu nyi zla bzhin du shar/ /byin rlabs drod 'jam sems can kun la phan/ /sems nyid lus la ma brten na/ /sems nyid gzugs can ma yin pas/ /sus kyang de la gzhom mi nus/ /lus la mngon par zhen gyur na/ /lus kyi sdug bsngal sems la gnod/ /gzhan gyi ngan smras mtshon rdo dang*/ /skom dang bkres dang 'chi ba rnams/ /lus can rnams la byung ba yin/ /de bas lus med lus kyi mchog /lus kyi zhen pa spang bar bya/ /da lta lus la ma chags na/ /bar dor bag chags yid kyi lus/ /nges par 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lus dang bral ba'i sems nyid de/ /nam mkha' bzhin du gnas pa

yin/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i sems nyid la/ /bag chags rdul gyis gos mi 'gyur/ /dper na nam mkha'i ngang nyid la/ /dkar rtsi nag rtsi gang mi chags/ / de bas sems nyid rten med la/ /dge sdig gang yang gos mi 'gyur/ /de bas rig pa rten med 'di/ /lta ba yin par bka' nas gsungs/ /da rung lus la chags gyur na/ /ya ki skra yi rtse mo nas/ /rkang mthil rtse mo yan chad du/ /lhu gzugs don snying so sor phye/ khrag dang mgo lpags de bzhin phye/ /de ltar phung po zhig pa yis/ /chags su lhung ba ma mthong bas/ /de lta bas na rang gi sems/ /yul med lus med sems med bzhag /bsam med sgom pa yin rtog pa/ /bsam pa don can ma yin shes/ /de bas de la blo mi gtod/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ 'bad pa don ldan gyi le'u ste nyer bzhi pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ grub mtha' yin lugs kyi dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /so so skye bo zhes bya ba/ /las rnams so sor bsags pa yis/ /de 'bras so sor skye ba na/ /so sor skye bo zhes kyang brjod/ /mu stegs chad pa zhes bya ba/ /byang chad cig la mu byas nas/ /rgyu rkyen med la stegs byas pas/ /sangs rgyas skal ba chad par snang*/ /chad pa zhes ni de la bya/ /mu stegs rtag pa zhes bya ba/ /'gyur med cig la mu byas nas/ /bag chags bde la stegs byas pas/ /tha mal chos las mi 'gyur bar/ /rtag pa po zhes de la bya/ /bde gshegs bka' yi gsung nyan kun/ /blos byas dbang gis ci yang mthong*/ /gsung gcig tu ni gsungs mod kyang*/ /du ma nyid du so sor thos/ /nyan thos zhes ni de la bya/ /rang nyid dad dang ldan pa des/ /rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi /'khor ba'i chos las rgyal bas na/ /rang rgyal zhes kyang de la bya/ /skye med byang chub rang gi sems/ /rang gsal chen por gnas pa la/ /yul du snang ba sems snang tsam/
/gzugs brnyan tsam du snang ba yin/ /sems tsam zhes kyang de la bya/ /rtag chad mtha' la mi gnas shing*/ /

'khor 'das mtha' la mi gnas la/ /dbu ma zhes ni de la bya/ /kri ni sku gsum rang bzhin la/ /ya ni thig le nyag gcig yin/ /kri ya zhes ni de la bya/ /u ni man ngag rang bzhin te/ /pa ni thabs kyi rgyal po yin/ /u pa zhes kyang de la bya/ /yo zhes bya ba ma lus pa/ /ga ni sems las 'gyur ba med/ /yo ga zhes kyang de la bya/ /ma ni 'khor 'das bskyed pa'i yul/ /hā ni bri ba med pa'i dbyings/ /ma hā zhes kyang de la bya/ /a ni skye ba med pa ste/ /nu ni bde ba chen po'i ngang*/ /a nu zhes kyang de la bya/ /a ni ma skyes pa yin te/ /ti ni btsal du med pa'o/ /a ti zhes kyang de la bya/ /theg dgu byang chub sems yin pas/ /lta yang byang chub sems la lta/ /sgom yang byang chub sems la sgom/ /ci spyod byang chub sems la spyod/ /sku gsum 'bras bu sems la bsgrub/ /ci tsam lta sgom gzhi phye yang*/ /de nyid rtogs na dri ma med/ /rtsol med ngang la gnas par bya/ / zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ grub mtha' bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer lnga pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ dgongs ldem bstan pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /rgyu yi byang chub rgyu la spyod/ /smon pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /pha rol phyin pa drug la rim gyis bslabs/ /de yang ji ltar yin zhe na/ /shul ring mgron po'i rgyags su sbyin pa sme/ /ser sna 'jur 'gegs can la brda de thongs/ /lus sems rgyan dang cha lugs tshul khrims brjid/ /lus ngag 'chol bar spyod la brda de thongs/ /nyon mongs dgra tshogs 'joms la bzod pa dpa'/ /zhe sdang khong khro can la brda de mthongs/ / 'phags lam bden pa bgrod pa brtson 'grus mgyogs/ /don med le lo can la brda de thongs/ /yang dag don chen rtogs par bsam gtan myur/ /'jig rten g.yeng ba can la brda de thongs/ /tshig mkhas chos kyis chos min g.yeng rnams

la/ /don la grangs kyi sems kyi g.yeng ba thong*/ /ma rig mun la shes rab sgron me gsal/ /'jig rten log shes can la brda de thongs/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras bu lam du 'khyer/ /de yang ji ltar 'khyer ba yin zhe na/ /dbang dang byin rlabs bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gis/ /sems nyid bzhu brtul byas nas rtsal sbyangs pas/ /dug lnga ma spangs ma sbyangs rang byung du/ /bde chen da lta nyid du rang la 'bar/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du 'byung ba'i blo mi skye/ /rig 'dzin rig pa'i rgyud de 'bras bu rang la 'char/ /snying po don gyi byang chub sems nyid ni// snying po sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa'i dgongs pa len/ /gang la mi gnas gnas pa med pa ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dgongs pa de ltar len/ /snying po tshul khrims pha rol phyin pa'i dgongs pa ni/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi 'du shes bsam dang bral/ /byed pa med pa'i dgongs pa rang bzhin gnas/ /skad cig de ltar gnas kyang tshul khrims mchog /snying po bzod pa'i pha rol phyin pa'i dgongs pa ni/ /bde dang sdug bsngal tsha grang ci byung yang*/ /sdug bsngal mdog ma 'gyur bar zhal bltas pas/ /mdog spu ma brjes chos nyid ngo bo mthong*/ /chos nyid gzhan nas 'byung re'i ltos pa zad par 'gyur/ /snying po don gyi bzod pa de bzhin bsgom par bya/ /snying po brtson 'grus pha rol phyin pa'i dgongs pa ni/ / lus ngag yid kyi ched du bya ba ni/ /rdul tsam med par gnas pa ni/ /rtog ge'i brtson 'grus rnams dang mi mthun pa'i/ /bya ba med pa'i brtson 'grus chen por gnas pa ni/ /rtsol ba med pa'i rtsol ba'i mchog tu dgongs pa longs par gyis/ /snying po bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa'i dgongs pa ni/ /'dod pa'i yid kyis bsam gtan mi bsgoms kyang*/ /'khor 'das gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs nas/ /gang yang mi bsgoms pa yi don la rab gnas nas/ /snying po don gyis byang sems sgom pa yin/

/ci phyir zhe na rang bzhin sgom yin pas/ /rang la dpag na sgom rgyu med ces bya/ /snying po don gyi bsam gtan de ltar yin/ /snying po don gyi shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i dgongs pa ni/ /shes dang shes bya gnyis su ma mchis pas/ /shes byed rig pa rdul tsam ma skyes na/ /skye med yongs la khyab pa'i dgongs pa ni/ /yin tsam min tsam dgongs pa mi mdzad na/ /snying po don gyi shes rab de ltar yin/ /bya rtsol kun dang bral zhing zhe 'dod blo dang bral/ /pha rol phyin drug skyes bu de la tshang*/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ byang sems rnam gsum dgongs ldem bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer drug pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ yin lugs bstan pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /gshe ba la yang slar mi gshe /brdeg pa la yang slar mi brdeg /mtshang 'bru la yang slar mi 'bru/ /ngan du brjod la'ang slar mi brjod/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yin/ /dad pa lhangs kyis skye ba ni/ /rgyu yi byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /rtogs pa lhangs kyis skye ba ni/ / 'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /rtog dpyod gnyis la mi gnas na/ / snying po'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /tshul khrims sdom la gnas pa ni/ /rgyu yi byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /srung du med pa'i don rtogs na/ /'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /bsrung ba dang ni mi bsrungs pa'i/ /rtog dpyod gnyis las 'das pa ni/ /snying po'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /dka' thub bzod pa sgom pa ni/ /rgyu yi byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /dgra zun nye ring med pa ni/ / 'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /nye ba dang ni ring ba yi/ /rtog dpyod gnyis las 'das pa ni/ /snying po'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /lus ngag chos spyod brtson pa ni/ /rgyu yi byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /rtsol bral dgongs pa lon pa ni/

/'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /rtsol ba dang ni mi rtsol pa'i/ /rtog dpyod gnyis las 'das pa ni/ /snying po'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /mnyam nyid ngang la 'jog pa ni/ /rgyu yi byang chub sems dpa' yin/ / mnyam nyid g.yo ba med pa ni/ /'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ / mnyam pa dang ni mi mnyam pa'i/ /rtog dpyod gnyis las 'das pa ni/ /snying po'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /bden pa gnyis la spyod pa ni/ /rgyu yi byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /bden gnyis dgongs pa lon pa ni/ /'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /don dam dang ni kun rdzob kyi/ /rtog dpyod gnyis las 'das pa ni/ /snying po'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /sa lam rim par bgrod pa ni/ /rgyu yi byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /sa lam sbyangs sems med pa ni/ /'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /sa dang lam dang byang chub sems/ /rtog dpyod gnyis las 'das pa ni/ /snying po'i byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /yin min rtsis las 'das pa ni/ /bzang ngan rtsis las 'das pa yin/ / mu mtha' yongs su grol ba yin/ /ris med phyogs las 'das pa yin/ /dpe don gnyis las 'das pa yin/ /bya byed gnyis las 'das pa yin/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ yin lugs bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer bdun pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ snying po don sgom pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /snying po bsgom par 'dod pa'i sgom chen pas/ / gang yang mi bsgoms pa ni mchog tu gsungs/ /sgom dang bsgom bya gnyis las 'das pa yin/ /ci snang yid la byed pa'i sgom/ /byung tshor 'gegs par byed pa'i sgom/ /rang bzhin rnal mar bzhag na sgom pa yin/ /mi bsgoms pa ni snying po nyid kyi sgom/ /sgom med sgom yod gnyis su 'byung ba yang*/ /snying po sgom du med par gnas pa yin/ /rgyu 'bras sgom du yod pas ston pa yin/

/yod med gnyis las 'das pa'i snying po yin/ /dang po don ma rtogs par ni/ /yang dag snying po bsgrub par bya/ /snying po bsgrubs nas snying po rgyun du phangs/ /snying po med pa ston byed bla ma de/ /de bstan brda ru shes nas thog ma snying po'i don/ / ngo mtshar rmad du 'byung ngo slob dpon ngo mtshar che/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid las ni/ /rkyen las skyes pa'i rtog pa sna tshogs pas/ /mi yis phyugs skyong phyugs kyis mi skyong ngam/ /mi yis gru skyel gru yis mi skyel bzhin/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis la lta spyod kyang*/ /de bzhin nyid du mkhas pas dgongs par rigs/ /'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa' de ltar yin/ /snying po'i byang chub sems dpa' de ltar yin/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ snying po'i don sgom pa'i le'u ste nyer brgyad pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ 'byung ba lnga sgom du bstan pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po yin/ /'byung bzhi nga las byung zhing nga yi ngo bor gnas/ /'byung lnga bzhin du sgom la bslab par bya/ /mi 'gyur rtogs med ri bo bzhin du ni/ /sgom chen rnams kyang mi rtog bsgom par bya/ /che la dang ba rgya mtsho bzhin du bsgom/ / 'gyur ba dngos med skyi bser bzhin du bsgom/ /'bras bus rgyu bsreg me bzhin bsgom par bya/ /rang bzhin stong la bdag med pa yi chos/ /nam mkha' ltar sgom zhes kyang de la bya/ /sgom med sgom pa de bzhin bsgoms pa des/ snying po'i don la bags kyis gzhol bar 'gyur/ /mnyam nyid bsgoms pas sna tshogs dran gyur na/ /rgya mtsho'i gza' skar bzhin du rig par bya/ /snang tsam la yang yod pa mi srid pas/ /de ltar shes pa'i sgom chen bde ba che/ /e ma ho/ gangs zhus mtsho la mtsho 'khyags gang*/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das rtogs ma rtogs kyang*/

/de bzhin nyid du shes dgos shes pas chog /chab rom mthong na chu dag de ltar rtogs/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs kun kyang de bzhin nyid/ /rtogs pas rang grol dgongs pa len pa ni/ /mi rtog ye shes sgom pa'i sgom pa yin/ / ma rtogs rtogs bral sgom pa'i sgom chen ni/ /rtog pa chen po bsgoms te rang ma rig /snying pos snying po bsgoms pas snying po 'khor bar zags/ /ci skyes snying por rtogs na snying po rang chas yin/ /rang stong rang snang rang gsal gnyis med ngang la 'char/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ 'byung ba lnga sgom pa'i le'u ste nyer dgu pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las btsal du med pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /dam chos spangs nas bde ba 'tshol ba de/ /skyel ma spangs nas 'jigs lam zhugs pa 'dra/ /'khor ba spangs nas mya ngan 'das 'tshol ba/ /dngos po spangs nas grib ma 'tshol ba 'dra/ /rgyu spangs 'bras bu 'tshol ba ni/ /myu gu spangs nas 'bras 'dod 'dra/ /skyon spangs yon tan 'tshol ba de bzhin nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /'khor ba nyid nas mya ngan 'das/ /thams cad sems su bya ba yis/ /sems shes pa las sangs rgyas yod/ /sangs rgyas pa la skye ba med/ /skyes par snang yang skye med dbyings/ /skye med dbyings zhes bya ba ni/ /rtsis las 'das pa kho na'o/ /snga phyi med la rgyu 'bras gzhi nas med/ /grub par snang yang bag chags yin pas na/ / yid ches mi bya rang nyid btson du gzung*/ /de bas snga phyi'i bsu skyel mi byed par/ /ci byung ci byed ci shar de bzhin nyid du zhog /thabs dang shes rab ldan na dmyal ba nyid kyang bde/ /rang sems ma shes bde ba bsgrubs kyang sdug / gdung ba'i sems dang bral na yi dwags gnas kyang phyug /'dod pa'i sems dang ldan na phun sum tshogs kyang bkres/ /sems la dal ba thob na bya ba ci byed bde/

/ci byas lung khungs stor na nyal nas 'dug kyang brel/ /rang gis rang la 'dzin na legs par snang yang 'khrul/ /rang gnyer byed mkhan stor na snying po lhun gyis grub/ /sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs na shes pa med kyang mkhas/ /rtogs pa'i gdeng chen med na sde snod shes kyang blun/ /rang grol dgongs pa longs la spyod lam rnam bzhi bsgom/ /rig pa btson du bcug na zhi bar gnas kyang yengs/ /sems la rang dbang thob na sdug bsngal byung yang dpa'/ /nyon mongs dbang du song nas stag ltar mchongs kyang sdar/ /dngos snang zhen pa med na stong nyid rtag tu bsgom/ /byams pa sems la bsgoms na su dang 'khon pa med/ /rtsa ba sems su bcad na phyi dgra rang sar 'gro /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ btsal du med pa'i dgongs pa bstan pa'i le'u ste sum cu pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ sems kyi gnas lugs bstan pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /skye rga na 'chi 'khor ba'i gcong snying 'di/ /thog ma med pa'i dus nas rang la gnas/ /rang ngo ma shes sdug bsngal rang bzhin te/ /bla mas mtshon pas rang ngo shes gyur na/ /rmi lam sad pas sdug bsngal grol dang mtshungs/ /sems nyid nam mkha' rtog pa sprin bzhin gnas/ /nam mkha' bsal phyir sprin rtog bsal snyam nas/ /rtsol ba'i stobs kyis 'bad pa ci byas kyang*/ /ched du 'bad pas 'bad pa nyid kyis bsgribs/ / 'bad med rang bzhin bzhag na grol bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas 'dod pas sangs rgyas mi thob ste/ /log rtog 'du shes spangs pa sangs rgyas yin/ /rtog pa'i sems la log rtog gyi na tsam/ /bcos pa med pa'i rang bzhin rang sar sangs/ /ma rtog dug lnga'i pho nya 'khor bar 'gyed/ /rtogs na de nyid ye shes rol par 'char/ /ma rig sems can thugs rje thabs kyis sgrol/ /rang rgyud dag pas gzhan rgyud grol bar nus/ /nyon mongs can gyis grol ba gang nas grol/

/sangs rgyas 'bras bu rang rgyud dag pa'i dbyings/ /'gro don mi 'byung ba lta smos ci dgos/ /nyon mongs bsal na nub mo nam gsal bzhin/ /shes bya'i sems kyis 'khor ba'i rang bzhin gsal/ /shes bya grol ba mi rtog chos dbyings gsal/ /rtogs ni chos rtogs yon tan ldan/ /bsgoms pas skyon yon gnyis su med/ /bshad pas chags sdang 'byed ma shes/ /bsgrubs pas grub pa'i mtha' ma rnyed/ /da yod rang thang so mar 'jog /byang chub sems dpa' rang yin pas/ /gzhan du sgrub pa da ni spongs/ /ma bltas lta ba'i mchog yin pas/ /blta bya'i rtog pa da ni spongs/ /sgom pa nyid kyis dmigs par 'gyur/ /bsgom bya sgom byed da ni spongs/ /spyad pas re dogs rtog pa mchod/ / rtsol sems spyod pa da ni spongs/ /sa lam bgrod pas ring du song*/ /sa bgrod lam sbyong da ni spongs/ /bde 'dod bsgoms pas rtog pa mchod/ /dmigs pa'i rtsal sgom da ni spongs/ /snying rje bsgoms pas bdud mtha' bskor/ /'gro don theg chen da ni spongs/ /'dul khrims bsrungs pas khyim du tshud/ /bcas pa'i chos ni da ni spongs/ /sdom pa ma nyams rlom sems 'byung*/ /btsun po'i gang zag da ni spong*/ /byed pa po ni rtsa ba mthong*/ /byas pa'i chos rnams da ni spongs/ /

gsog pa po yi rtsa ba mthong*/ /dge dang sdig ni da ni spongs/ /sgrub pa po yi rtsa ba mthong*/ /grub pa po ni da ni spongs/ /shes pa po yi rtsa ba mthong*// mkhas pa po ni da ni spongs/ /rtogs pa po yi rtsa ba mthong*/ /rtogs pa po ni da ni spongs/ /lta ba po yi rtsa ba mthong*/ /mthong ba po 'di da ni spongs/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ gnas lugs bstan pa'i le'u ste so gcig pa'o// // byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ smon lam rang chas kyi dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad yod kyang*/ /byang chub sems las gzhan yod min/ /byang chub sems kyi don rtogs pas/ /zhe sdang rang bzhin gnas su dag /dmyal ba'i btso bsreg mi 'byung ba'i/ /smon lam byang chub sems su thebs/ /byang chub sems kyis don rtogs pas/ /'dod chags rang bzhin gnas su dag /yi dwags bkres skom mi 'byung ba'i/ /smon lam byang chub sems su thebs/ /byang chub sems kyis don rtogs pas/ /gti mug rang bzhin gnas su dag /byol song bkol spyod mi 'byung ba'i/ /smon lam byang chub sems su thebs/ /mi la sogs pa de bzhin mtshungs/ /srid rgyu nyes pa'i rtsa ba gcig pu ba/ /rang sems ma rig bdag tu 'dzin pa yin/ / bdag 'dzin rtsa ba yang bltas yang bltas pas/ /bltas pas ma mthong lta byed rang sar dag /rta shi g.yag 'gyel bzhin du shes par bya/ /rang rgyud grol ba las ni ma gtogs pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gzhan na yod min pas/ / mchog gi dngos grub thob ces de la bya/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas kyang*/ /smon lam sems su thebs so e ma ho/ /dug lnga rang sar grol lags pas/ /ye shes lnga yi 'dod pa zad/ /dug lnga ye shes gnyis med pa'i/ / smon lam byang chub sems su thebs/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba med mthong bas/ /bde ba ma bsgrubs rang bzhin gnas/ /bde dang sdug bsngal med pa yi/

/smon lam byang chub sems su thebs/ /de ni thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /smon lam zhes kyang de la bya/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ smon lam rang chas kyi le'u ste so gnyis pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'jug pa las thun mong smon lam gdab pa'i dgongs pa 'di gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas bla med byang chub thob pa yi/ /rgyu dang rkyen du 'byung gyur cig /tsha ba'i dmyal ba'i me dpung gis/ /grang ba'i dmyal ba dros gyur cig /grang ba'i dmyal ba'i lhags pas kyang*/ /tsha ba'i dmyal ba bsil gyur cig /tsha grang gnyis su med rtogs nas/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /byol song gti mug phag pa yi/ /ci mthong zas su 'gyur bzhin du/ /yi dwags bkres skom de bzhin shog /bkres skom gtsang btsog gnyis med pa'i/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /'gro ba mi yi bsam dgongs kyang*/ /chos la sems pa ma yin pa'i/ /log shes bsam pa mi 'byung zhing*/ /mi lus gyur dang ldan par shog /'gro ba lha dang lha min kyang*/ /longs spyod chos la byed par shog /'thab rtsod ltung ba med gyur nas/ /theg chen chos la spyod par shog /bsam pas grub pa'i chos de yang*/ /rtag tu chos la sems par shog /bsam pa bzhin du 'grub gyur cig /sems can ma lus thams cad kyang*/ /rang gi sems la dbang thob shog /sems nyid rin chen bzhag lags pas/ /phyi yi snang ba bde 'gyur shog /bcings pa rnams ni grol gyur shog / gtan gyi so nam zin gyur cig /'gro ba'i nad ni ma lus pa/ /kun gyi rab tu zhi bar shog /rang sems bdud du ma langs par/ /bde chen rang la 'char bar shog /sems can kun gyi lam ston shog /'di bris pa yi bsod nams kyis/ / sems can ma lus thams cad kyang*/ /sdig pa kun las grol nas kyang*/ /rtag tu bde la spyod par shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /'khor ba'i bag chags med pa dang*/

/gol grib skyon rnams sel ba dang*/ /nyi ma nor bu ji bzhin du/ /kun gyi 'phrin las mdzad par shog /yul gyi gtso bo dbang chen yang*/ /rang gros rang gis 'debs par shog /dug lnga ye shes lnga nyid kyang*/ / gnyis med gcig tu gros 'debs shog /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /spros pa med par dbang thob shog /byan mo mdzangs ma thams cad kyang*/ /sdig pa'i bu lon ma chags shing*/ /dge ba'i lkog rdzas gsog par shog /so nam las thabs ma nor zhing*/ /ci g.yo tshogs su 'gro gyur cig /bu dang bu mo tshar byed bzhin/ /'gro ba kun la de bzhin du/ /byams pa'i sems dang ldan gyur shog / dpa' brtan rem pa thams cad kyang*/ /bdud dpung 'joms la rem par shog/ dge ba'i chos la blo brtan shog /rnam rtog g.yul ngor gsod par shog /nyon mongs g.yul ngo bzlog par shog /ston pa rnams kyi thos bsam yang*/ /rang gi rang rgyud grol byas nas/ /sems can 'khor ba las grol shog /'dus pa'i sems dang ldan gyur cig /gang gis gang la mos pa la/ /thad ka'i re 'dun skong gyur shog /bsam gtan sgom pa'i sgom chen rnams/ /sems can rnams kyi don ched du/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin mthu ldan nas/ /nyon mongs gnas su grol bar shog /mngon shes drug dang ldan gyur nas/ /rgyal po rnams kyi rgyal khrims ni/ /chos khrims ched du 'byung gyur cig /'bangs rnams dbang du 'dus pa yang*/ /chos bzhin du ni 'dus par shog /rgyal po stan las ma g.yos par/ /thams cad dbang du sdud pa ltar/ /sems nyid don las ma g.yos par// sna tshogs dbang du 'dus par shog /'bangs rnams sri zhu che bar shog /rgyal po u pa rā dza bzhin/ /sdig spyod rgyal por ma gyur par/ /rgyal po dharmā rā dza bzhin/ /chos skyong rgyal por 'byung 'gyur shog /mkha' la nyi shar bzhin du ni// dam chos nyi ma shar bar shog /me tog char chu dus 'byung bzhin/ /nad rnams thams cad zhi ba dang*/

/rtag tu bde ba thob par shog /dpon g.yog ma lus bde legs dang*/ /bkra shis phun sum tshogs gyur cig /zhes byang chub sems dpa'-i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ thun mong smon lam 'debs pa'i le'u ste so gsum pa'o// //rgyu'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa/ 'bras bu'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa/ snying po'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // bkra shis pa'i tshig /mkhas btsun gshe skur mi 'debs shing*/ /mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad mi 'byung zhing*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /athi+-i/ bde bar gshegs pa phag mo gru pas mdzad pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i bstan chos lags so/ /bzod pa dka' thub bzod pa dam pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs/ /rab tu byung bas gzhan la gnod pa dang*/ /gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no gsungs so/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun/ /ma rig sems dang dag pa'i sems ma gtogs/ /de las logs pa gzhan na ma mchis pas/ /de ltar gnyis med dag pa'i 'bras thob shog/ // mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i gsung*/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug - PAGE 48 -- PAGE 49 -- PAGE 1 -
